frame: body axes x fwd, y left, z up; gravity (0,0,-g); SI

A_replica.model: 2-D rigid translation, explicit SCM shear law (see module docstring)

C_utilisation.basis: demand = |internal (scaled from 5.13.3 by theta^2 and opposing-pair series stiffness) + V sin(alpha) along the slope| upper bound (aligned); capacity = c A + N tan(phi) (soil-soil, = saturated SCM shear); interface: adhesion 0.5 c, delta = 2/3 phi

E_swivel_tilt.criterion: pad hanging on the swivel ball, h above the bottom: stable iff k_r > N h, k_r = k_area I (Winkler; I = min second moment of the pad polygon about its centroid). k_area: plastic (virgin loading, Bekker tangent n p / z), secant p / z, elastic K (unloading/reloading)
